digest.component_or_area: store epoch guard at sync union and push retry sites
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epochs reaching sync._union_merge must return without merging and preserve both local and remote refs unchanged.
A stale clone with mismatched epochs reaching push.py non-fast-forward retry must abort immediately, returning from push_tickets_branch without merge or re-push attempts.

The epoch guard must check the remote .store-compat.json via git show, distinguish between file-absent and ref-unreadable errors, and abort on epoch mismatch, non-string epoch values, or corrupt records.
A merely-behind clone with matching epochs must converge via fast-forward adoption, and a strictly-ahead clone must return early; neither blocking case is treated as epoch mismatch.
After a guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING) with local and remote tips byte-for-byte unchanged.

The epoch value is a JSON string (ISO-8601 UTC instant plus random suffix), preserved through write_compat_record when already present, never generated by pre-reclaim code, and compared only for byte equality.
